| Skill | Trigger | Path |

| acceptance | when deciding whether something is done. Turn a request into observable criteria before writing code. | skills/acceptance/SKILL.md |
| bootstrap | when someone wants to start a project from scratch, asks what odachi is, or does not know where to begin. Do not load it inside a project that is already odachi. | skills/bootstrap/SKILL.md |
| commits | when deciding what goes into a commit, how to split the work, or what the message and PR description say. | skills/commits/SKILL.md |
| data | when data has to be saved, migrated, read or deleted. Decide owner, lifetime and backup before writing the first row. | skills/data/SKILL.md |
| drive | when you work inside an odachi project: which verb goes at each moment, what each block means and how a feature closes. To start from zero, use bootstrap. | skills/drive/SKILL.md |
| go-tests | when writing or reviewing Go tests, golden files or Bubbletea flows. Load `tests` for the discipline and this skill for the concrete pattern. | skills/go-tests/SKILL.md |
| pull-request | when a change goes to a PR or the diff passes 400 lines. Split the delivery into reviewable work units and pick one chain strategy. | skills/pull-request/SKILL.md |
| ship | when something is ready for another person to use. Verify the installer's path, not the developer's. | skills/ship/SKILL.md |
| skill-craft | when writing a new skill, fixing one that is not being used, or deciding whether something deserves a skill. | skills/skill-craft/SKILL.md |
| skill-improve | when a skill is not used, grew too long or the agent does not load it. Audit the trigger, cut the body and validate the format again. | skills/skill-improve/SKILL.md |
| slices | when a large request has to be split into small steps, when the code no longer fits in one read, or when deciding whether to delegate to a subagent. | skills/slices/SKILL.md |
| tests | when writing, fixing or deciding what a change tests. The failing test first, the code after. | skills/tests/SKILL.md |
| triage | when there are several bugs, a backlog or a report that repeats. Classify by root and fix once, not once per issue. | skills/triage/SKILL.md |
| writing | when writing a message, a PR description, an issue comment, or documentation someone will read to act. | skills/writing/SKILL.md |
